newsitem.title: CANADA: TABLE-CANADA LEADING INDICATOR RISES 0.8 PCT IN JULY.
newsitem.headline: TABLE-CANADA LEADING INDICATOR RISES 0.8 PCT IN JULY.

text.p: The Canadian composite leading indicator rose 0.8 percent in July to 197.2 (base 1981) after a revised 0.9 percent rise in June, Statistics Canada said on Friday.

The indicator foreshadows economic activity by tabulating figures for sectors that rise or fall in advance of broader movements in the economy. The figure is "smoothed," reflecting a moving average of approximately the past five months.
The unsmoothed index, reflecting the past month only, fell 0.3 percent in the month to 199.3.
